reading.title: Taxes or bans?
reading.text: Many governments want to reduce childhood obesity, but they disagree about how. Some have imposed taxes on sugary snacks. Others have proposed banning food advertising during children's programmes, since young viewers are exposed to thousands of adverts each year. Food companies strongly oppose both ideas, arguing that exercise is the most important component of good health. In the UK, a planned advertising ban was postponed twice before it finally came into force.
